description: Defines a router for event type-related API endpoints, including various CRUD operations and related procedures, using tRPC and dynamic imports.

methods.name: getByViewer
methods.description: Handles fetching event types by viewer with performance logging.

methods.name: getUserEventGroups
methods.description: Handles fetching user-specific event groups with performance logging.

methods.name: getEventTypesFromGroup
methods.description: Fetches event types from a specific group with performance logging.

methods.name: getActiveOnOptions
methods.description: Retrieves active-on options with performance logging.

methods.name: listWithTeam
methods.description: Lists event types with team information.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Imported get procedure for event types.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an event type with role-based access control.

methods.name: bulkUpdateToDefaultLocation
methods.description: Updates multiple event types to default location.

methods.name: getHashedLink
methods.description: Retrieves a hashed link for an event type.

methods.name: getHostsForAvailability
methods.description: Fetches hosts available for an event type with role restrictions.

methods.name: getHostsForAssignment
methods.description: Fetches hosts for assignment with role restrictions.

methods.name: exportHostsForWeights
methods.description: Exports hosts for weights with role restrictions.

methods.name: getChildrenForAssignment
methods.description: Fetches child entities for assignment with role restrictions.

methods.name: getHostsWithLocationOptions
methods.description: Fetches hosts with location options with role restrictions.

methods.name: massApplyHostLocation
methods.description: Applies host location in bulk with role restrictions.
